title: Eyvah Boşandım
author: Özgür Uçanok
description: Some stories begin with a wedding; others begin again with a signature. Oh No, I’m Divorced! is a courageous and deeply honest collection of real-life accounts from people who have experienced the emotional upheaval of divorce. Through stories of fractured relationships, broken hearts, unfinished dreams and difficult decisions, the book explores what happens when a bond once believed to be permanent begins to fall apart, and when what appears to be an ending reveals itself as the collapse of an illusion. Candid, moving and ultimately empowering, these personal narratives illuminate the many faces of separation while following individuals as they confront loss, rediscover their identities and learn to rebuild their lives. Challenging the idea that divorce represents failure, the book presents it as a possible turning point: not simply the loss of another person, but the beginning of finding one’s way back to oneself.
